title: Ghost and Cipher
author: Juniper Sterling
blurb: Emrys Ashgrove, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
